question: What RGB values are listed in Table 2A-2 for fluorescent yellow-green?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2A-2 does not list RGB values for fluorescent yellow-green or any other color. It is a matrix of "Common Uses of Sign Colors," indicating (with X marks) which colors are used for legends and backgrounds by sign type — for example, fluorescent yellow-green appears as a permitted background for pedestrian and bicycle warning signs and school signs. Precise color specifications are defined by federal regulation, not by RGB values in this Manual. Standards (mandatory): - "The colors to be used on signs and their specific uses on signs shall be as provided in the applicable Sections of this Manual. The color coordinates and values shall be as described in 23 CFR, Part 655, Subpart F, Appendix." (i.e., colorimetric specifications reside in the CFR appendix, not in Table 2A-2.) Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows Table 2A-2 as a checkbox-style matrix of legend and background color uses by sign type, with fluorescent yellow-green columns marked for Warning–Pedestrian, Warning–Bicycle, and School signs, and no RGB or numerical color values anywhere in the table. Citations: - Section 2A.06 Standard §1 (p.43) - Table 2A-2 (p.43)
